subject: general
question: What is the focus of the National Technical Textiles Mission?

options.text: Providing subsidies for fashion apparel industry

solution:
The correct answer is __**Growth of technical textiles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **National Technical Textiles Mission** was approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs in February 2020.
 
• The mission aims to promote the **growth of the technical textiles sector** in India through research, development, and innovation.
 
• It is a four-year program (2020-21 to 2023-24) with a budget allocation of **₹1,480 crore**.
 
• The mission focuses on areas like **agro-textiles, geo-textiles, medical textiles, and protective textiles**, among others.
 
• It also emphasizes **capacity building and skill development** to strengthen India's position as a global leader in technical textiles production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Technical Textiles**

 
 
• Technical textiles are **functional fabrics** designed for specific applications rather than aesthetics, such as agriculture, healthcare, construction, and defense.
 
• They include products like **medical implants, protective clothing, airbags, and industrial filters**.
 
 
 
• **Components of the Mission**
 
 
• The mission has four components: **Research, Innovation, and Development; Promotion and Market Development; Export Promotion; and Education, Training, and Skill Development**.
 
 
 
• **Global Market**
 
 
• The global technical textiles market is projected to grow significantly, offering India an opportunity to become a leading exporter.
 
• India aims to increase its market share in global technical textiles from **4% to 10%** by 2024.
 
 
 
• **Import Substitution**
 
 
• India currently imports a significant portion of technical textiles. The mission aims to **reduce dependence on imports** by promoting domestic production.
